caseName: Lehnhausen v. Lake Shore Auto Parts Co.
caseNameFull: Lehnhausen, Director, Department of Local Government Affairs of Illinois v. Lake Shore Auto Parts Co. and Barrett, County Clerk of Cook County, Illinois v. Shapiro

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ill. [Certiorari granted, 405 U. S. 1039.] Motion of Lake Shore Auto Parts Co. for leave to withdraw as a party respondent in No. 71-685 denied. Motion for order requiring petitioners to recognize “Maynard Respondents” as parties to the litigation denied without prejudice to seeking leave to appear as amici curiae.
